{{Wireless adapter |brand=Qualcomm |model=65-VF320-P2 |revision= |upc= |ean= |asin= |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=01/18/2008 |manuf_country= |is_manuf=No |manuf= |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |availability=unreleased |if=Mini PCI (long) |if_bus_version= |if_connector_type= |form_factor= |vendor_id= |device_id= |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |id_string= |fcc_id=J9C-65VF320P2 |ic_id=2723A-65VF320P2 |chip1_brand=Qualcomm |chip1_model=WFB4030;WFB4030, A0840.04, C27150003, Wafer 02; |chip2_brand=Qualcomm |chip2_model=WFR4031 |chip3_brand= |chip3_model= |chip4_brand= |chip4_model= |addl_chips=2.4/5GHz Front End Module;Jacket Micro Devices;M20007;JMD, M20007, 000032, 0723;2; |accessible_UART=No |flags= |ant_conn=U.FL |802dot11_protocols=abgn |txchains=2 |rxchains=3 |sstreams=2 |oui=00:0A:F5 |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} This device (alternate model '''''MA423D_H''''') uses '''Qualcomm''''s WFB400 chipset (the successor to '''Airgo''''s AGN300 chipset). It was likely never publicly released.
"701-00210-0E" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos.
A MAC label w/ a 00:0A:F5 ('''Airgo''') OUI is affixed to the device in the FCC photos. It has been assigned to this entry for no reason.
